name: Prodigy of Lei Shen lets Stormflow critically strike natively (#885)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Prodigy of Lei Shen 560023 a single self-targeted APPLY_AURA effect: aura 286 SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT, SpellFamilyName 22, EffectSpellClassMask [0, 65536, 0]. Every Stormflow rank (567555, 572861-572867) carries SpellFamilyName 22 and SpellFamilyFlags [0, 65536, 0], so the mask matches. The aura type has a real consumer: AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodicData calls AuraEffect::CalcPeriodicCritChance (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1175-1205), which returns 0.0 unless the caster's spell-mod owner holds a SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT effect whose IsAffectedOnSpell (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1207-1216, via SpellInfo::IsAffected, SpellInfo.cpp:1437-1449) matches the periodic spell; the resulting crit chance is snapshotted onto the periodic aura effect at application and rolled on every tick (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:6542). No module code touches aura 286 or family-22 class masks (grep for SpellFamilyName == 22 / CLASS_STORMBRINGER over modules/mod-ascension-compat/src/*.cpp: 23 hits, none on ApplyAuraName or SpellClassMask), and 560023 appears in zero source/SQL files, which is the false positive the audit's source-grep method produces for natively delivered passives. The control player never learns 560023 and keeps the same Static resource and cast setup as the talented player, so the only difference between the two is the passive; aura_crit_chance reads AuraEffect::GetCritChance(), the exact value CalcPeriodicCritChance stored, and spell_done_crit_chance reads the same Player::SpellDoneCritChance() the periodic path calls, confirming the two sources agree instead of asserting an invented constant.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learning Prodigy of Lei Shen applies its passive aura
The control's Stormflow channel is live
The talented Stormbringer's Stormflow channel is live
Let the first Stormflow tick land
The control's Stormflow periodic aura landed
The talented Stormbringer's Stormflow periodic aura landed
BASELINE: without Prodigy of Lei Shen, Stormflow's ticks cannot crit
DISCRIMINATING: with Prodigy of Lei Shen, Stormflow's ticks carry the caster's spell crit chance

Cross-check: the talented caster's PLAYER_SPELL_CRIT_PERCENTAGE1(Frost) register is positive -- the exact stat CalcPeriodicCritChance's internal SpellDoneCritChance(skipEffectCheck=true) call reads for Stormflow (DmgClass MAGIC, SchoolMask FROST) and snapshots onto the aura; the harness's spell_done_crit_chance metric cannot express this because it hardcodes skipEffectCheck=false, and Stormflow's periodic-only effects fail SpellInfo::IsCritCapable (no SCHOOL_DAMAGE/HEAL/etc effect), so that metric always returns 0 for this spell regardless of the passive
